title: Detailed snowman
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='snow' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#FFFFFF'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#BFD8F2'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='snowB' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#F2F8FF'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#A9C6E8'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='snowH' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#FFFFFF'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#B7D2EE'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- ground shadow -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='93' rx='40' ry='5' fill='#5B7FB5' opacity='0.55'/>

  <!-- bottom snowball -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='76' r='18' fill='url(#snow)' stroke='#9EBCDF' stroke-width='1.2'/>
  <path d='M35 70 q6 -4 12 0' stroke='#D6E6F7' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M52 84 q6 3 12 -2' stroke='#D6E6F7' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- middle snowball -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='54' r='13.5' fill='url(#snowB)' stroke='#9EBCDF' stroke-width='1.2'/>
  <path d='M42 50 q5 -3 10 1' stroke='#E4EFFA' stroke-width='1.4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- buttons -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='47' r='1.7' fill='#3A3A55'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='53' r='1.7' fill='#4A4A6A'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='59' r='1.7' fill='#3A3A55'/>

  <!-- scarf tail -->
  <path d='M60 43 q9 4 8 14 q-1 6 -5 9 l-5 -3 q4 -4 3 -9 q0 -5 -4 -7 z' fill='#E0453E' stroke='#FF8A70' stroke-width='1'/>
  <path d='M63 47 q4 3 3 9' stroke='#FFB0A0' stroke-width='1.2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- scarf band -->
  <path d='M37 42 q13 6 26 0 l2 6 q-15 7 -30 0 z' fill='#E0453E' stroke='#FF8A70' stroke-width='1'/>

  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='31' r='11' fill='url(#snowH)' stroke='#9EBCDF' stroke-width='1.2'/>
  <path d='M43 24 q4 -3 9 -2' stroke='#FFFFFF' stroke-width='1.4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='46' cy='29' r='1.9' fill='#2B2B44'/>
  <circle cx='54' cy='29' r='1.9' fill='#2B2B44'/>
  <circle cx='46.6' cy='28.4' r='0.6' fill='#CFE0F5'/>
  <circle cx='54.6' cy='28.4' r='0.6' fill='#CFE0F5'/>

  <!-- carrot nose -->
  <path d='M50 32 L59 34 L50 36 Z' fill='#FF8C1A' stroke='#FFB85C' stroke-width='0.8' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
  <path d='M51 33.4 L56 34' stroke='#FFD39B' stroke-width='0.7' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- smile (coal dots) -->
  <circle cx='44' cy='38' r='1' fill='#2B2B44'/>
  <circle cx='47.5' cy='39.6' r='1' fill='#2B2B44'/>
  <circle cx='52.5' cy='39.6' r='1' fill='#2B2B44'/>
  <circle cx='56' cy='38' r='1' fill='#2B2B44'/>

  <!-- hat brim -->
  <rect x='35' y='20' width='30' height='4' rx='2' fill='#2E3B6E' stroke='#6E86C8' stroke-width='0.9'/>
  <!-- hat top -->
  <path d='M40 20 L41 8 q0 -2 2 -2 h14 q2 0 2 2 L60 20 z' fill='#33427A' stroke='#6E86C8' stroke-width='0.9'/>
  <!-- hat band -->
  <rect x='40' y='15' width='20' height='3.5' fill='#E0453E' stroke='#FF8A70' stroke-width='0.7'/>
  <!-- hat highlight -->
  <path d='M43 9 q1 -1 3 -1' stroke='#9FB3E8' stroke-width='1' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- left twig arm -->
  <path d='M37 50 L22 40' stroke='#8A5A2B' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M28 44 L25 38' stroke='#8A5A2B' stroke-width='1.6' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M33 47 L31 52' stroke='#8A5A2B' stroke-width='1.6' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- right twig arm -->
  <path d='M63 50 L78 41' stroke='#8A5A2B' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M73 44 L77 39' stroke='#8A5A2B' stroke-width='1.6' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M68 47 L70 53' stroke='#8A5A2B' stroke-width='1.6' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- falling snowflakes -->
  <circle cx='14' cy='20' r='1.3' fill='#DDEBFA'/>
  <circle cx='86' cy='26' r='1.3' fill='#DDEBFA'/>
  <circle cx='20' cy='62' r='1.1' fill='#DDEBFA'/>
  <circle cx='82' cy='66' r='1.1' fill='#DDEBFA'/>
  <circle cx='12' cy='45' r='1' fill='#C9DDF3'/>
  <circle cx='88' cy='48' r='1' fill='#C9DDF3'/>
</svg>
